// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 200;
  const height = options.height ?? 200;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  // vl2d3: unsupported data source (expected inline "values" or a "url"), using an empty dataset (--ignore-unsupported)
  let data1 = [];


  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  // vl2d3: unsupported mark type "geoshape", drawing as "point" instead (--ignore-unsupported)
  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => width / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => height / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 500;
  const height = options.height ?? 300;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/world-110m.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));


  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  // vl2d3: unsupported mark type "geoshape", drawing as "point" instead (--ignore-unsupported)
  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "lightgray")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => width / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => height / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 200;
  const height = options.height ?? 200;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  // vl2d3: unsupported data source (expected inline "values" or a "url"), using an empty dataset (--ignore-unsupported)
  let data1 = [];
  // vl2d3: unsupported data source (expected inline "values" or a "url"), using an empty dataset (--ignore-unsupported)
  let data2 = [];


  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  // vl2d3: unsupported mark type "geoshape", drawing as "point" instead (--ignore-unsupported)
  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "aliceblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => width / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => height / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  // vl2d3: unsupported mark type "geoshape", drawing as "point" instead (--ignore-unsupported)
  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data2)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => width / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => height / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  return svg.node();
}
